message.content:
These are in `file.c` which is the command-line tool, not the library. The fuzzer calls `magic_buffer` which goes through the library code. The heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 is likely in the library code (like `src/magic.c`, `src/funcs.c`, `src/ascmagic.c`, etc.).

Let me look at the OSS-Fuzz issue 42513013. The issue number suggests it's from around July 2022. Let me look at the commits right after `f042050f` that touch library files (not just `file.c`).
